edges.reason: Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner slot.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the token decimals.
Constructor writes the fixed total supply.
Constructor credits the whole supply to the deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient credit.
safeAdd performs the raw addition a + b.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction a - b.

safeDiv performs the raw division a / b.
transfer executes the safeSub debit against balances[msg.sender].
transfer executes the safeAdd credit against balances[to].
transferFrom executes the safeSub debit on balance and allowance.
transferFrom executes the safeAdd credit on the recipient.

transferFrom consumes the caller address to look up its allowance.

Owned constructor derives owner from the untrusted deployer address.
